models.uniform: each feasible injective assignment has weight 1
models.ownership: product 1/(number of notes in the assigned source group)
models.cover_behavior: timing weight times 1/16 for cover-to-active or user-to-idle; unknown and same-policy behavior weight 1

clustering: known common source ownership and known common destination ownership are merged; unknown identities are not certified independent
conditioning: at least one exit assigned to target source; whole source group
